title: fail to open device with multiple interface usb device on windows
body:
I am trying to use the webusb api to connect my USB device which basically is a digitizer.  the usb version is 2.0.
I have successed to request the device in chrome but failed to open the device with the error Access Deny.
![1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34373032/79357880-295abb00-7f73-11ea-856f-b0cd6ae9b943.png)

the first hid interface is used to report digitizer which i think it is already claimed by the system. I guess that is the issue because I have tried to remove the two hid interface and repeat the process. this time the device is opened successfully.

however the same issue is not presented on Mac OS. 
so i am wonder if anyone has any suggestion to solve the issue on windows?
